newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel prices fall with diesel and NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel prices fall with diesel and NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell on Thursday by up to a cent a gallon tracking both heating oil futures on NYMEX and weakening spot diesel prices at the U.S. Gulf Coast (USG), traders said.
Prompt USG airline-quality 54-grade material was heard, but not confirmed, done at 2.50 cents over April futures, after changing hands at 3.00 cents over in the early going.

Refiner buyers that had helped firm diffs in recent sessions were out of the fray today, which helped fortify the weakening trend. Markets in NY Harbor meanwhile remained illiquid with diffs notionally unchanged, traders said.
-- Oliver Ludwig New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
